about: Notification entity made by the per-frame update of esv::notification::System from each esv::background::GoalRecordedEventOneFrameComponent (a background goal of a character was achieved; seen in the GOB_GuardUpset dialogue and the companion-death scenario, born with eoc::background::GoalsComponent, eoc::notification::BackgroundGoalComponent and eoc::analytics::EventGoalAchievedComponent). Same shape as SE's eoc::notification::BackgroundGoalComponent (EntityHandle, Guid, uint32).

evidence.says: bg3.exe+0x2DF2000 (add helper, 0x20 bytes) sets +0 to the null handle 0xFFC0000000000000; bg3.exe+0x2DE7840 copies the event's +0 (GoalRecordedEvent.Entity, 0x28-byte stride) into it; live 0x0200003300000A2E-like handles
bg3.exe+0x2DE7840 copies the event's 16 bytes at +8 (the background goal Guid, GoalRecord.Goal in esv::background::GoalSystem::Update) to +8
bg3.exe+0x2DE7840 writes the constant 4 (a kind/enum value); live 4
zeroed by bg3.exe+0x2DF2000 (it writes 0 as one 8-byte value at +0x18), never written; live 0

open_questions: meaning of the constant 4 at +0x18 (enum name not known)
